notes.title: Otok Update v1.10
notes.notes:
Update v1.10 adds a new style, Santorini, based on the small Greek island Santorini.  As well as some other new functions, a couple of controls, and some settings.


Added:

 - Path Mode, which makes the game only pick objects that I considered to be "paths". (those objects may change)

 - End Island Early, some people have let me know that they sometimes had a cool-looking island, which was then ruined because they needed to fill out the rest of the tiles.  This function, as the name suggests, allows you to end the island early so that you don't need to fill out the whole thing.

 - Space bar control, pressing the space bar will pop up two buttons, which activate the two previously mentioned things. (Path mode, and the End Island Early Buttons)

 - Added to Controls, some people mentioned it was sometimes hard to find the missing tiles that needed something placed on them.  So, if you click on the lighthouse, it lights up all empty tiles (this was in the game but just not communicated to the player in any way)

 - Added camera tilting towards mouse position, as well as a setting button to disable it.

 - Added Quality settings of high and low.

 - Added the ability to zoom with the scroll wheel.



Changes:

 - Adjusted exit menu background darkness.



Fixed:

 - Fixed transparency of unplaced buildings, now all buildings are transparent prior to being placed.



Okay, hope you enjoy the new style, have fun!


Make sure to wishlist the game if you think it looks cool.
And if you get the game, I would greatly appreciate a review. :)

notes.title: Otok 1.08 Update
notes.notes:
Otok version 1.08

What is included?

v1.08 has the all new Sandbox mode.  What is Sandbox Mode? Sandbox mode is the new mode where you can use any of the buildings in the game to craft your little island city.  Random mode is still the base mode, but it is easy to switch between the two modes in the settings.

Prior to Otok's Release, I may add some more things to this mode.
